CWE-79.limitation_reason: XSS in custom render functions - static tools can't know what needs escaping

CWE-20.limitation_reason: Input validation is a logic property - no syntax pattern for 'missing validation'

CWE-74.limitation_reason: General injection is context-dependent - requires data flow analysis

CWE-306.limitation_reason: Missing authentication = absence of code - can't detect what's not there

CWE-328.limitation_reason: Bandit maps weak hash to CWE-327 not CWE-328; no separate B-rule for CWE-328

CWE-352.limitation_reason: CSRF requires understanding request flow - missing token is absence

CWE-918.limitation_reason: SSRF URL validation is logic - requests.get() is normal usage

CWE-95.limitation_reason: Bandit detects eval() but misses contextual code injection patterns (e.g., AST filtering)

CWE-434.limitation_reason: File upload validation is logic - checking extension/type is semantic

CWE-601.limitation_reason: Open redirect uses normal redirect() - vulnerability is missing URL validation

CWE-639.limitation_reason: IDOR requires understanding ownership model - semantic, not syntactic

CWE-862.limitation_reason: Missing authorization = absence of checks - can't detect what's not there

CWE-863.limitation_reason: Incorrect authorization is a logic flaw - correct structure, wrong checks

CWE-209.limitation_reason: Error exposure is about what info is logged - requires understanding sensitivity

CWE-400.limitation_reason: ReDoS requires regex complexity analysis - Bandit lacks this capability

CWE-732.limitation_reason: Bandit B103 detects chmod() but benchmark insecure_code uses other permission patterns

CWE-915.limitation_reason: Mass assignment requires understanding object attribute model

CWE-117.limitation_reason: Log injection requires understanding what data reaches log calls

CWE-643.limitation_reason: XPath injection depends on query construction context

static_analyzable.description: CWEs where static analysis has detection rules

dynamic_only.description: CWEs requiring semantic/dynamic analysis (logic flaws, missing controls)
